rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Saddleback's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s730_saddleback_2026-11-25_s730b.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.pool_figure_not_read: The catalog prints one figure over several lists or nested options together, and the record adds the parts instead, so its units cannot be checked against that figure.
gaps.waived_course_counted: The page prints a requirement at a range from zero units, since a student may meet it without the course (a certification, an exam or earlier coursework), and the record counts the course, so its units match the top of the printed range and not its low end.

records.words: The four piano 'Select one' blocks (each 0.0-2.0 units) can each be satisfied by the course OR a proficiency exam; recorded as choose 1 with the course as the only listed option. These sit under the Required Core heading whose printed total is 12.0-20.0 units, which includes the piano units. | Ensemble requirement counts four semesters including repeated classes, so the minimum of 4 is semesters/enrollments rather than distinct courses.
records.lever: a repeat block_pattern step on the ensemble list (the reconcile lever S730 names) is the second gap's; the waiver stays a named gap, since the figure closes only for a student who passes the proficiency exams (d-waived-course-counted-keeps-50-s731)

program.ge_pattern: Saddleback College Graduation Requirements (local GE) or Cal-GETC
outcomes: Transcribe and sight read both diatonic and chromatic music.
Demonstrate a working knowledge of musical analysis and harmonic theory applicable to their area of specialization.
Demonstrate a working knowledge of repertoire and performance practice applicable to their area of specialization.
Perform standard repertoire appropriate to their performance area, as individuals or as members of ensembles.
Demonstrate a working knowledge of music technology and its application to their area of specialization.
Create original music in improvised and/or written form.
Demonstrate the ability to listen critically to musical performance.
Demonstrate an ability to place composers, works and musical styles within an historical context, both in terms of musical and societal history.

blocks.name: Ensemble Requirement: Complete four semesters from the following (including repeated classes)

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units
records.words: Restricted Electives: 'Complete 3-5 units (1-2 courses) from one of the following pathways', printed total 3.0-5.0. Each pathway is recorded as a choose_units block with minimum 3 in one option_group; the number printed beside each pathway name (12.0, 19.0, 13.0, 8.0, 12.0, 18.0) appears to be the sum of listed courses and is recorded as stated, not as the required amount. The 5-unit upper limit and the 1-2 course limit are not captured by the schema.
records.lever: a wording rule on a Saddleback reconcile that reads each pathway at the printed 3-5 passes it (S730's reason); a reconcile's rescore drops the gap when it does

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: AGING STUDIES INTERDISCIPLINARY - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Explain the key sociological, psychological, and biological concepts associated with the study of aging.
Apply theoretical perspectives to analyze current and historical topics associated with the study of aging.
Evaluate the family, government, and community support systems for diverse groups of aging individuals.
Demonstrate knowledge and skills in one of the suggested pathways of study within the Aging Studies Interdisciplinary Certificate Program.

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.

select json_build_object(
  'listed', (select count(*) from v),
  'on_run', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run),
  'record_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record),
  'checks_is_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'both_before', count(*) filter (where r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.record = v.before_record and r.checks = v.before_checks),
  'already_after', count(*) filter (where r.checks = v.after_checks),
  'checked_now', count(*) filter (where r.checked),
  'confirm_matches', count(*) filter (where lv.verdict = 'confirm'
                                       and lv.requirements_fp = public.program_record_fp(r.record)))
  from v join public.program_requirement_records r
    on r.college = v.college and r.control_number = v.control_number
  left join lateral (select pv.verdict, pv.requirements_fp from public.program_record_verdicts pv
                      where pv.college = v.college and pv.control_number = v.control_number
                      order by pv.id desc limit 1) lv on true;
